entries.name: Dumbbell Front Raise
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, side view. The text allows one or both arms; this draft shows both, as a labelled bilateral demonstration. The arms flex forward from in front of the thighs to shoulder height with a soft elbow, the trunk and legs stay still, and the lowering is slower than the raise. The bells are held palms back, so they read end-on from the side.
entries.summary: Raise both dumbbells straight ahead to shoulder height with a soft elbow, then lower on a slow count.

frames.caption: Stand holding the dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing back.
Raise both arms straight ahead with a soft elbow.
Lift to shoulder height while the torso stays a pillar.
Hold at shoulder height with the hands soft.
Lower on a slow count, slower down than up.
